ops.note: Note (1): threshold 'unchanged at seventy per cent (70%)'; Table 1-1 total is now 120 marks; the operative wording of 11.3 is replaced by ADD-03:6.2.

ops.old: sixty-five per cent (65%) technical and thirty-five per cent (35%) commercial
ops.new: seventy per cent (70%) technical and thirty per cent (30%) commercial

ops.note: Note (3): marks on the Authority's standard five-point scale multiplied by the weight shown (same as ADD-02 note (3)).
Note (4): Energy Performance Statement shall be included in the Technical Proposal in the format at Appendix C to ADD-03; Appendix C is not in the evidence build.

ops.new_text: A Proposal whose technical score is less than seventy per cent (70%) of the total marks available in Table 1-1 shall not proceed to commercial evaluation.
The Envelope B of a Proposal that does not proceed to commercial evaluation shall be retained unopened by the Authority and returned to the Bidder after the Preferred Bidder Notification.

ops.note: Conditional: ADD-03 Section 7 (deletion of the Authority's grid connection point) has effect only if the Authority notifies through the Portal not later than ten (10) Working Days before the Proposal Due Date (calculate: Thursday 12 November 2026 on the current due date of 26 November 2026) that the grid connection point will not be energised at least 12 months before the Scheduled PCOD; otherwise Section 7 lapses. Clause 1.4 stands unamended until such notice.
Form 4-H in Arabic, signed and stamped by an authorised signatory of each member; Arabic text (Appendix A, image) governs; Appendix B English for convenience only.

Form 4-H with Envelope A; a member incorporated outside the Kingdom may instead submit through the Portal not later than five (5) Working Days after the Proposal Due Date (calculate on 26 Nov 2026: 2 Dec 2026 counting the due date, 3 Dec 2026 not counting it; counting rule not stated in the pack).
Failure to submit a complete and properly executed Form 4-H for each member by the time required by 8.3 renders the Proposal non-responsive.

ops.old: A Proposal scoring less than seventy (70) marks out of one hundred (100) at the technical evaluation shall not proceed to commercial evaluation and its Envelope B shall be returned unopened.
ops.new: A Proposal whose technical score is less than seventy per cent (70%) of the total marks available in Table 1-1 shall not proceed to commercial evaluation.

ops.new_text: The Envelope B of a Proposal that does not proceed to commercial evaluation shall be retained unopened by the Authority and returned to the Bidder after the Preferred Bidder Notification.

statements.text: The Proposal Due Date of 26 November 2026 is not changed by any ADD-03 provision outside this batch (VOL-I:6.1 shows the same effective text at stage ADD-03); the dates in A2 and A3 depend on it.

Note (1) of the Notes to Table 1-1 (second revision) does not change VOL-I:11.3 by itself; it confirms the 70% threshold that ADD-03:6.2 writes into the new Clause 11.3. Calling it 'unchanged' is inaccurate in substance: with 120 marks available, 70% is 84 marks, not the former 70 marks out of 100.

Note (4) adds an obligation to include an Energy Performance Statement in the Technical Proposal; it is tied to criterion G (ADD-03:T1-1/G). The format cannot be established because Appendix C is not in the evidence (A4).
Note (3) restates the scoring method of ADD-02 Note (3) without change and has no effect beyond confirmation.

Section 7 of ADD-03 is conditional: until the Authority gives the Portal notice described in 7.1 (by 12 November 2026 per A2), VOL-II:1.4 stands unamended; whether the notice will be given is not known at the evidence date. The engine has no conditional op type, so 7.2 cannot be applied as a plain replace_text.
'to be inserted after Form 4-G' in ADD-03:8.1 means after the list item that ADD-02/7.1 inserted into VOL-I:9.1 (VOL-I:9.1(e)+ADD-02, 'FORM 4-G — CYBERSECURITY COMPLIANCE UNDERTAKING').

Because 8.2 makes the Arabic text govern, the 10% threshold in the Arabic Form 4-H (F5) would prevail over the 25% in Appendix B; this needs a person and possibly a clarification to the Authority, and depends on the image reading being approved.
